name: Image
summary: A framed image with rounded corners and a hover preview mask.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-image> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `src`/`alt` set the picture, `width`/`height` the frame, and on hover the image scales while a mask fades in — both animate on a persistent node via the shared motion tokens. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: The hover scale + mask fade live on a persistent node (only the :hover pseudo-class changes, never a subtree rebuild), so the transition always fires. Clicking (or Enter/Space on) the frame opens a modal preview overlay — a persistent node faded/scaled in on the shared tokens, never rebuilt on open. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Frame
spec.value: radius 8px · bg #F7F7F7 · overflow hidden · role=button, keyboard-focusable

spec.label: Image
spec.value: object-fit cover · scale 1.06 on hover, motion-slow ease-out

spec.label: Preview
spec.value: click/Enter opens a modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal); Esc / close button / backdrop dismiss; focus moves in and is restored on close

a picture is one part of a larger grouped surface

opinion.note: Always set alt for accessibility. Keep the mask label short — 'Preview', 'View' — it is an invitation, not a caption.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Image cell; spec derived from the token layer (radius-default, bg-container-secondary, bg-overlay, text-inverse) + antd Image conventions (hover mask preview). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
